source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives the three product-model normalizations, converts the sharp bound to a normalization-constrained ratio optimization, establishes two conservative Proposition 3 values with exact special cases, and explicitly leaves sample-data development as future work.

The paper treats propensity-, outcome-, and subset-confounding sensitivity models for MSMs, including time-varying treatments, with efficient estimators and confidence intervals; it is not Tan's product-ratio model.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies a distinct average-case propensity-ratio model, derives sharp closed-form average-potential-outcome bounds, one-step estimators, and multiplier-bootstrap simultaneous bands.
The paper develops inference for known directionally differentiable maps and motivates derivative-aware rather than ordinary bootstrap methods.
